# Versions of: The first round trip

1 published version of [The first round trip: a sovereign website made for Kate Curtis-Evans during our call, five designs from a design agent of its own, then handed over so she edits it herself from her own Claude, the friction that took multiple rounds to get through, what it says about over-privilege, and the next step, a signed and sealed channel from her site straight to the agent](../the-first-round-trip.md). The current one is **v1.0.0**.

v1.0.0 is the article as first published. A change to its text (title, abstract or body) is the next minor version, v1.1.0; a change only to its other details (a LinkedIn link, the release it belongs to) is the next patch, v1.0.1. The list is read from the site's git history at every build, so it cannot be edited by hand and cannot leave a version out. Views extracted from an article, such as the Five readers, are not part of its text and do not change its version.
